entities.name: Air France Flight 212 (1969)
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Air France Flight 212 was a scheduled passenger flight from Santiago International Airport, was flying to Paris, France via Lima, Peru; Guayaquil, Ecuador; Bogota, Colombia; Caracas, Venezuela; Pointe-à-Pitre, Guadeloupe; and Lisbon, Portugal operated by a Boeing 707, registration F-BHSZ, that crashed on 3 December 1969. All 62 people on board were killed.
